pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high-frequency serrated edges. Individual patches exhibit star-like angularity with sharp pixel-level protrusions into the corridors. Spatial area of patches is larger on the neck and shoulder, reducing in size towards the ventral area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, exhibiting narrowing at the closest points between patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the upper neck. The mane presents a repetitive, jagged silhouette against the background caused by individual hair clusters.
